features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.desc: You gain proficiency in the Arcana or Nature skill, and you learn the Prestidigitation or Druidcraft cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.desc: You learn two Arcane Shot options; once per turn you can apply one of them to a shot from a bow (2 uses, regained on a rest). New options at levels 7, 10, 15, and 18.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.desc: You make a nonmagical arrow magical to overcome resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.desc: When you miss with a magic arrow, you can use a Bonus Action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet of the original one.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.desc: If you have no uses of Arcane Shot left when you roll Initiative, you regain one use.
